name: seedicon-site
description: Marketing site + playground for the seedicon package. Never published to npm.

scripts.//prebuild: Builds the parent package before Next.js compiles, because the site imports it via file:.. and dist/ is gitignored. --include=dev is required: Vercel sets NODE_ENV=production, and npm ci skips devDependencies in that case — which is where tsup and typescript live.
scripts.prebuild: cd .. && npm ci --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build
